mission: Approach to the valley epicenter. Torin visible on the ridgeline — already descending, already deploying the technique at personal scale. Final Ben/Torin exchange across distance.
why_now: The three-way convergence beginning — all parties moving toward the Scar simultaneously
conflict: Ben's last attempt to reach Torin across the distance — through the Force, through words, through shared experience. Torin hears him. Responds with genuine affection. And keeps walking.
turning_point: Torin's voice, carried across the valley: 'I understand what you're trying to do, Ben. It's the right impulse. But some problems only have one solution.' The use of 'Ben' — not 'Skywalker' — carries warmth that makes it worse.
opening_hook: The valley opens below them. Three-way geometry: Veraine at the Scar, Torin descending the ridgeline, the resonance group at mid-valley. Desh already gone — heading to the first amplification node.
closing_hook: Torin begins the technique. Ben feels it — the lattice near Torin leaning toward him and dissolving. A pulling, a suction. Like standing next to a drain. The climax begins.
emotional_trajectory: Desperate hope for Torin -> the failed appeal's grief -> the technique activating

stakes.personal: Ben's last chance to save Torin — and the acceptance that he can't force it
stakes.interpersonal: The Ben/Torin relationship's final exchange — genuine love across irreconcilable choices
stakes.external: The three-way convergence at the Scar is about to collide

setting: Veranthos — valley approach, ridgeline visible, the Scar at the valley floor
sensory_details: The valley's geometry — ridgelines, slopes, the Scar at the lowest point; Torin's descending figure; the technique activating — the lattice leaning toward Torin, dissolving, a cliff edge between structured and unstructured Force; Veraine's ritual visible at the Scar as distant distortion
notes: Torin using 'Ben' instead of a title or surname carries enormous weight. The failed appeal should hurt because it comes from love, not conflict. Torin isn't rejecting Ben — he's rejecting Ben's approach while admiring Ben's character.
